The path defines a closed shape with four vertices: (73,72), (9,72), (9,37), (73,37).  
These points form a quadrilateral with horizontal and vertical sides only.  
The top and bottom sides are horizontal (same y-values), left and right sides are vertical (same x-values).  
All interior angles are 90°, and opposite sides are equal in length.  
This matches the definition of a rectangle.  

Final answer: (H)
